verdict.rationale: Helicone's first-party docs describe webhooks that send instant notifications when LLM requests complete. These can be filtered so that only requests matching all specified properties trigger them, and they are meant for automating workflows, scoring responses, and integrating with external systems. That delivers the core of a programmatic event subscription. Missing for 10: documented event types beyond request completion, payload, signing and retry details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
